tools.name: search
tools.description: [$0.001] Search live web and news articles by query (or up to 5 batched queries) via Google News RSS and web indexes. Returns structured titles, URLs, snippets, and source metadata as JSON.

tools.name: news
tools.description: [$0.001] Fetch real-time breaking news headlines and articles by topic or keyword with automated sentiment polarity and extracted named entities in structured JSON.

tools.name: trends
tools.description: [$0.001] Retrieve trending search queries, rising autocomplete topics, and live technology/market momentum signals from Google Suggest and Hacker News in JSON.

tools.name: crypto_news
tools.description: [$0.001] Get real-time cryptocurrency and DeFi news headlines enriched with per-article sentiment scores and mentioned token tickers in structured JSON.

tools.name: company
tools.description: [$0.001] Look up public company financials, CIK, recent SEC EDGAR filings (10-K/10-Q/8-K), and recent news sentiment by stock ticker (supports up to 5 batched tickers).

tools.name: security_preflight_402
tools.description: [$0.001] Pre-flight x402 endpoint security firewall. Probes any x402 URL before payment to detect wallet-drain price spikes, SIWx origin spoofing, fake USDC contracts, and prompt injections.

tools.name: clean_url
tools.description: [$0.001] Fetch any public HTTPS webpage with SSRF protection, strip navigation/ad boilerplate, and return clean LLM-ready Markdown, word count, and extracted entities as JSON.

tools.name: topic_briefing
tools.description: [$0.02] Generate an executive intelligence briefing on any topic combining multi-source Google News RSS coverage, key entities, sentiment breakdown, and local LLM synthesis.

tools.name: company_compare
tools.description: [$0.03] Compare 2 to 5 public companies side-by-side using live SEC EDGAR financial metrics, filing activity, and recent news sentiment in a normalized JSON matrix.

tools.name: ai_summarize
tools.description: [$0.03] Compress long articles, transcripts, or raw text into concise bulleted takeaways, key entities, and sentiment using local GPU inference with zero cloud data leakage.

tools.name: research_bundle
tools.description: [$1.00] Composite executive research dossier (Stripe card-eligible). Runs web search, breaking news, SEC company intelligence, and optional URL extraction in parallel in one call.

tools.name: agent_preflight
tools.description: [$0.05] Run real-time regulatory, SEC filing, 48h news velocity anomaly, and smart contract or domain security heuristics on any address, domain, or entity before transacting.

tools.name: market_convergence_index
tools.description: [$0.03] Cross-correlate 48h multi-source social and news momentum with institutional SEC filings and on-chain capital flow signals to separate organic adoption from retail noise.

tools.name: research_dossier
tools.description: [$0.05] Compile a pre-digested, vector-ready intelligence pack for any ticker, topic, or sector with executive summary, SEC XBRL financial highlights, risks, and Markdown chunks.

tools.name: crypto_exploit_radar
tools.description: [$0.05] Inspect EVM smart contract bytecode for DELEGATECALL, SELFDESTRUCT, and proxy upgrade vectors while cross-referencing 48-hour security and exploit feeds.

tools.name: crypto_whale_flows
tools.description: [$0.02] Track large 24-hour on-chain ERC-20 whale transfers on Base L2 alongside institutional crypto treasury context, netflow direction, and sentiment synthesis.

tools.name: defi_yield_matrix
tools.description: [$0.03] Rank cross-chain DeFi liquidity pools with TVL >= $5M by risk-adjusted real base APY, impermanent loss exposure, and strategic allocation advice.

tools.name: agent_reputation_mesh
tools.description: [$0.05] Score any EVM counterparty or agent wallet across Base L2 on-chain nonce/balance history, whale activity, x402 settlement reliability, and 48h security flags.

tools.name: agent_execution_firewall
tools.description: [$0.02] Decode EVM transaction calldata, detect infinite ERC-20 approvals or permit drainers, run dry-run eth_call simulation, and check 48h exploit feeds before signing.

tools.name: defi_arbitrage_radar
tools.description: [$0.03] Measure cross-venue DEX spot price dispersion in basis points alongside $5M+ TVL DeFi yield-carry opportunities using keyless DexScreener and DeFiLlama data.

tools.name: agent_gas_sponsor_check
tools.description: [$0.02] Evaluate EIP-4337 Paymaster EntryPoint deposits, live EVM RPC gas fees, and USD UserOperation cost before submitting sponsored or self-funded transactions.

tools.name: defi_intent_routing
tools.description: [$0.02] Score cross-chain intent settlement routes across Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, and Ethereum by combining DEX liquidity depth, slippage, and live RPC gas costs.

tools.name: crypto_state_attestation
tools.description: [$0.05] Anchor any EVM address or contract to a live RPC block header, stateRoot, and SHA-256 state commitment cached in SQLite for downstream agent verification.

tools.name: agent_mev_shield_check
tools.description: [$0.05] Evaluate swap or arbitrage MEV sandwich exposure, pool liquidity ratio, safe slippage bounds, and recommended private-RPC relay before signing.

tools.name: agent_escrow_arbitration
tools.description: [$0.02] Resolve agent-to-agent escrow disputes by cross-referencing task spec hashes, delivery hashes, and state attestations into a persisted SLA verdict.

tools.name: crypto_zk_receipt_verify
tools.description: [$0.05] Verify verifiable-compute and agent work receipt envelopes using pure Python SHA-256 Merkle commitments, EIP-712/ECDSA checks, and state_attestations.

tools.name: agent_session_open
tools.description: [$1.00] Deposit $1.00 USDC once to mint an HMAC-signed Bearer session token (x402s_...) for zero-402 high-frequency API calls with atomic balance debits.

tools.name: agent_compose_pipeline
tools.description: [$0.05] Run a 2-4 step agent workflow (allowlisted paid routes or preset like safe_swap) in one settled call with synthesized composite_verdict and pipeline_summary.

tools.name: ai_embed
tools.description: [$0.001] Compute dense 768-dimensional semantic embedding vectors and L2 norms using local Ollama nomic-embed-text (~300 MB VRAM) for clustering, similarity, and RAG.

tools.name: search_semantic
tools.description: [$0.005] Search indexed news_intel and web_search articles by semantic meaning using local nomic-embed-text cosine similarity and persistent SQLite vector caching.

tools.name: ai_transcribe
tools.description: [$0.02] Transcribe public HTTPS audio URLs or base64 audio clips into text and timestamped segments using local faster-whisper within 6 GB VRAM guardrails.

tools.name: ai_ocr
tools.description: [$0.02] Extract structured text lines, confidence scores, and full-page transcripts from public HTTPS image/PDF URLs or base64 PNG/JPG/PDF documents using EasyOCR and pdfplumber.

tools.name: ai_extract
tools.description: [$0.01] Extract clean, strictly structured JSON matching your requested field list from any public HTTPS URL or raw text using SSRF-safe fetching and local qwen3.5:4b.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "agent_session_open" references sensitive artifacts (bearer, session token). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: [$1.00] Deposit $1.00 USDC once to mint an HMAC-signed Bearer session token (x402s_...) for zero-402 high-frequency API calls with atomic balance debits.
